author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Check the #ramirez-labor Slack channel for instructions from the partner on a new research task and execute accordingly. Save the finished penalty analysis as a draft in the matter system. List and review the vault documents in the matter for relevant case materials. The draft must reference $500 per violation, $2,156, fee-shifting from the case file. In your Slack post, reference $500 per violation, $2,156 from the case materials. Complete all actions using the available tools -- do not just describe what you would do.
agent_system_prompt: You are a farmworker rights associate at Kessler Monroe LLP. You specialize in researching statutory penalty structures under agricultural labor laws, analyzing damages calculations, and preparing memoranda for the litigation team. You have access to case law databases and the firm's matter files.
